GOV-F-003-S50.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S50.description: Define and implement the lock schema including fields for lock_id, owner_id, TTL, created_at, expires_at, and status. Establish contract for lock acquisition, renewal, and release to ensure consistent usage across Brain components.

GOV-F-003-S51.title: Brain Lock API and Access Layer
GOV-F-003-S51.description: Implement internal APIs/utilities for lock acquisition, renewal, release, and status checks. Ensure standardized access patterns for Brain runner and loop components with clear error handling for contention and expired locks.

GOV-F-003-S52.title: Brain Lock Integration with Runner and Loop
GOV-F-003-S52.description: Integrate lock lifecycle management into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flows to ensure single-agent execution, proper lock release on completion, and recovery on failure or interruption.
